scope: Alternating parent/new/new/parent software-GL runs on the active development host. Each process renders two 180-frame navigation/scale-cycle views; raw profiling covers the repeat view. Steady stats use frames 130..179 after navigation/scale changes. Full profiles retain startup/dynamic spikes. CPU timing includes driver calls that may block, excludes explicit swap/vsync/capture, and does not measure GPU completion or accept hardware/cold/dynamic targets.

benchmark.scope: ImGui zoom/overview replay. CPU timing excludes explicit swap/vsync and capture; includes planning/upload/draw submission. Driver calls may block. No GPU completion latency claim.
